papers.title: Do LLMs Take Care of Their Own? Similarity Signals Can Induce Cooperation
papers.titleZh: 大语言模型会善待同类吗？相似性信号可诱导合作
papers.abstract: As LLM-based agents with user-instructed goals are becoming widely deployed, they increasingly encounter each other in strategic interactions, and face challenges of finding mutually beneficial outcomes. Prior literature has argued that cooperation problems such as the Prisoner's Dilemma are resolvable in settings where agents know they follow very similar decision making patterns, as for example in monocultural AI ecosystems. Following that line of work, this paper introduces the first framework for evaluating LLM decision making when agents are provided with graded similarity signals. Among our findings, we establish that different LLM models vary drastically in how they navigate similarity signals, with some modern models showing consistent behavior across cooperation problems, payoff structures, and prompt framing. Perhaps surprisingly, our experiments also show that the dataset based on which the similarity signal is computed has small to no impact on induced cooperation, and that LLM models systematically self-identify as highly similar when asked to evaluate another model's chain-of-thought reasoning by themselves. Finally, we develop an LLM-behavioral-game-theoretic model that captures some of their reasoning rationale, and show that it can support cooperative outcomes in equilibrium under sufficiently high similarity scores.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 随着大语言模型（LLM）代理在战略场景中频繁交互，如何促使其达成互利合作成为关键问题。传统博弈论假设代理决策独立，但现实中同源模型可能共享推理模式。本文探究当LLM获知彼此决策相似性时，是否会改变行为以促成合作，填补了基于相似性信号的合作机制实证研究空白。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究设计了一个两人对称博弈框架，其中每个LLM代理知晓与对手的‘相似性分数’（0%-100%），该分数表示双方在相同问题上推理结论的一致程度。代理目标仍是最大化自身收益，实验涵盖囚徒困境等混合动机博弈，并通过不同提示方式、收益结构和基准测试评估行为变化。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 实验发现多数现代LLM在高相似性信号下显著增加合作倾向，且行为符合一种介于纳什均衡与证据决策理论之间的新型均衡模型。特别地，当LLM自行评估对方推理链时，所生成的内生相似性信号更能稳定诱导合作，表明自我识别机制具有实际潜力。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者结合大规模实验与理论建模：通过在多种基准（如道德困境、人格测试）上计算响应一致性来构建外生相似性信号；同时引入‘b-相似性均衡’概念，形式化描述代理在考虑对方可能同步偏离时的最优策略，从而解释观察到的合作模式。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 研究依赖人工设定的相似性信号，且部分模型对无关基准也表现出合作，暴露了当前LLM易被语义标签影响的风险。尽管如此，论文首次系统验证了相似性作为合作机制的有效性，其框架、行为模型与内生评估设计对构建可信多智能体系统极具启发价值。

papers.title: How to Beat FCFS
papers.abstract: We study two observable queues with identical service rates, serving agents who arrive stochastically over time. Agents join the queue that minimizes their expected waiting time. Assuming one queue uses the ubiquitous First-Come-First-Served (FCFS) service rule, we show that by simply modifying its service order, the other queue can capture a strict majority of the demand. We establish an upper bound on the arrival share any rule can capture against FCFS. When both queues can design their service order, we show a novel variant of Last-Come-First-Served (LCFS) is an equilibrium in a low congestion regime. Without commitment, the picture changes, and there is an equilibrium where both queues use FCFS, and agents route to the queue with the shorter waitlist.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么一个队列可以通过改变服务顺序来吸引更多顾客？现实中许多服务系统（如医疗、云服务）通过等待时间竞争客户，而不仅仅是价格或容量。本文关注的问题是：当两个队列服务能力相同时，其中一个采用普遍的先到先服务（FCFS）规则，另一个能否仅通过调整服务顺序就赢得多数需求？这挑战了FCFS在竞争中稳健性的直觉。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型中有两个可观测队列，服务速率相同，顾客随机到达并选择预期等待时间更短的队列加入。每个队列可设计自己的服务规则，决定新来者的位置、谁被优先服务及服务后如何调整队列。研究聚焦于工作守恒规则，并比较不同规则在对抗FCFS时的表现，特别考察承诺能力对均衡的影响。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明存在一种名为‘账本规则’（Ledger rule）的服务机制，能在对抗FCFS时吸引超过一半的需求。该规则通过战略性预留有利位置来增强未来吸引力。此外，文章给出了任何规则对抗FCFS所能获取市场份额的上界（约70.7%），并发现低拥堵下存在双方使用保护型LCFS的对称均衡。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者使用耦合论证和再生过程分析来证明账本规则的长期优势：先展示其不劣于FCFS，再构造一个正概率事件使其严格占优。稳定性分析借助流体极限方法处理状态复杂性。上界推导结合了空队列概率和服务速率约束，利用马尔可夫链常返性和收益计算得出紧界。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 模型假设完全观测和事前承诺，削弱了在动态调整场景下的适用性。账本规则依赖对对手状态的观察，其实际部署需考虑信息获取成本。尽管如此，论文的价值在于揭示了服务顺序作为竞争工具的力量，提供了机制设计的新视角。最值得读的是其核心思想、上界分析和技术路线，尤其是流体稳定性论证的运用。

papers.title: Tolls for Dynamic Equilibrium Flows
papers.titleZh: 动态均衡流的收费机制
papers.abstract: We consider dynamic network flows and study the following question: Which dynamic edge flows can be implemented as tolled dynamic equilibrium flows? We study this question for the heterogeneous-user model, where the flow particles are partitioned into populations characterized by their own source,destination-pairs and a cost function associating with any walk and departure time some costs. As our two main results, we first provide a duality-based characterization of implementability of dynamic edge flows for the multi-source, multi-destination case. Secondly, we derive both, a combinatorial and duality-based characterization of implementability of dynamic edge flows for the multi-source, single-destination case. Both results are derived under a fairly general network loading model. For the proof, we make several technical contributions: We formulate a novel infinite dimensional optimization problem, where the goal is to minimize the aggregated costs of the particles with respect to the fixed network loading induced by the given edge flow. This requires the recently introduced concept of autonomous network loadings for which we show several new structural insights. In particular, we give an alternative (tighter) characterization of the existence of autonomous network loadings for our setting by deriving a generalization of a result of M.A. Zareckiĭ on the Lusin $N^{-1}$ property of absolutely continuous monotone functions which may also be of independent interest. These insights allow us to prove the stated characterizations under the assumption of strong duality. Finally, for the case of a single-destination, we are able to provide a non-trivial proof that this assumption is always fulfilled for finitely supported edge flows with costs representing weighted travel times.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 交通拥堵影响出行效率与环境，通过动态收费调节流量是重要手段。本文关注一个根本问题：哪些动态边流可以被实现为带收费的动态均衡？尤其在用户异质（不同时间价值）的情况下，现有静态模型结论不再适用，而动态模型中路径选择与时间传播更复杂，导致收费能否引导出特定流量仍不清楚。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型基于有向图上的动态流，粒子随时间从源点出发，经边到达汇点。每类用户有特定起点、终点和成本函数（如加权旅行时间）。边通行时间由当前流量决定，遵循先进先出原则。收费为匿名的时间函数，目标是判断是否存在收费方案，使得某一流量成为该收费下的动态用户均衡。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文给出了动态边流可实施性的充要条件。对于多源单汇网络，提出组合刻画：任何从汇点出发的零成本环路必须实际成本也为零。同时提供对偶刻画：存在一个最优解诱导出该流。这统一并推广了静态情形的经典结果，揭示了动态下环路行为的关键作用。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 核心是构造一个无穷维优化问题（P(u)），其目标是最小化在固定通行时间下诱导该流的总成本。通过强对偶性建立与收费的关系。关键技术是‘自主网络加载’，允许分析不同流入在固定时间函数下的传播，并结合绝对连续函数的Lusin性质，确保加载良好定义。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结果依赖于强对偶成立，虽在单汇有限支撑流下已证，但多目的地情况仍是开放问题。收费可能不连续，实现难度高。最值得读的是其模型抽象能力与对偶框架，为动态机制设计提供了新工具，相关工作梳理也极具参考价值。

papers.title: A Solution to the Roommate Problem
papers.titleZh: 室友问题的一个解决方案
papers.abstract: We extend the concept of priority-neutral matching, introduced by Reny (2022) in the school choice context, to the roommate problem. We prove three main results. First, a blocking-neutral matching always exists in constrained roommate problems under arbitrary feasibility constraints (Theorem 1). Second, the set of stable matchings is contained in the set of blocking-neutral matchings, which in turn is contained in the set of Pareto-optimal matchings (Theorem 2). Third, whenever stable matchings exist, the set of blocking-neutral matchings coincides with the set of stable matchings (Theorem 3). We also show that existence fails under weak preferences and extend the concept to two-sided school choice.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么有些分配问题无法找到稳定的配对方案？本文针对经典的室友问题——即如何将一组人两两配对——展开研究。传统上，稳定匹配要求无人愿意脱离当前搭档另组新对，但Gale和Shapley早已证明这类匹配未必存在。这导致实践中缺乏可靠解，因此需要一个既能继承稳定性规范含义、又具备广泛存在性的新解概念。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 作者考虑一个有限代理人的集合，每人对他人有严格偏好，并通过匹配函数将代理人两两配对或允许单人独处。引入任意可行性约束（如个体理性或房间容量），形成受限室友问题。核心创新在于定义‘阻塞中立匹配’：若某匹配被另一可行匹配改进，且改进过程中不使已受损害者面临新的正当抱怨，则原匹配不具中立性。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明三个关键结论：第一，在任意约束下，阻塞中立匹配始终存在；第二，稳定匹配必为阻塞中立，而阻塞中立匹配又必为帕累托最优，形成清晰的包含关系；第三，当稳定匹配存在时，阻塞中立匹配恰好退化为稳定匹配。这意味着该概念既扩展了稳定性的适用范围，又在原有可行情形下保持一致。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者采用非循环性论证来证明存在性：若阻塞中立支配关系构成循环，则利用引理表明阻塞对集合不会扩大，进而推出某一环节必然出现反向正当抱怨，导致矛盾。关键技术是构造一个随支配链递减的阻塞对集合，结合有限性确保最大元存在，从而避开直接构造匹配的困难。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 主要局限在于弱偏好下存在性不再成立，且双侧学校选择中的推广需额外处理不可比性。尽管如此，本文价值在于提供了一个兼具规范性和存在性的新解概念。最值得细读的是其对稳定性本质的重新诠释，以及如何通过局部阻塞行为定义全局合理匹配的建模思路。

papers.title: Located but Not Releasable: Silent Gate Inversion and Bounded Linear Release
papers.titleZh: 位于但不可释放：静默门控反转与有界线性释放
papers.abstract: A growing body of work reports that language models represent task-relevant latent structure that they fail to use. Whether such structure, once located, can be converted into behavior is a separate question that is rarely tested end to end. We submit the complete pipeline -- detect, localize, and release -- to a fully preregistered stress test on a 25.7M transformer trained on causal-evidence discrimination, where a known suppression phenomenon (latent causal structure present but behaviorally unused) has previously been documented. Every threshold, claim template, and decision-tree branch was hashed and archived before any corresponding data existed. Three findings. (i) Localization succeeds: interventions at observation-evidence channels of mid layers restore target behavior on otherwise-suppressed worlds (paired release advantages $0.563$ and $0.854$, 97.5% CIs excluding zero; best-site release rate $0.889$). (ii) Gating fails out of distribution: a detector calibrated to trigger on zero out-of-distribution calibration worlds triggers on 6.9-7.3% of held-out in-distribution generations and on zero of the 2,400 held-out generations that actually need it -- a complete inversion that silently reduces the gated pipeline to its base model. (iii) Linear release is capped: removing the gate and injecting a per-instance linear direction unconditionally yields a monotone dose-response that plateaus far below the preregistered release margin (intercept $0.382 \to 0.311 \to 0.264$ vs. threshold $\le 0.08$); per-instance adaptivity adds less than $\pm 0.03$. The failure is doubly located: the detector is OOD-inverted, and the entire family of linear release directions at this site and resolution is bounded away from sufficiency. The two failures are dissociable, and neither overturns localization. Every number traces to a hashed artifact in the released audit chain.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么找到模型内部的有用结构却无法转化为行为？当前解释性研究常假设一旦发现语义方向或关键神经元，就能通过干预改变输出，但越来越多证据显示这种‘表示-行为’之间存在鸿沟。本文聚焦一个已知现象：小规模Transformer虽能解码因果结构，却在决策中忽略它。问题核心在于，从定位到释放的完整管道是否真正可行，尤其是在预注册条件下端到端检验。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究在一个2570万参数的Transformer上进行，任务是区分观察相关与因果效应，特别关注混淆世界中的抑制现象。输入为基于结构因果模型的提示，输出为对do-intervention问题的回答。评估不仅看整体性能，更采用预注册协议，在CONF50、ID40等固定测试集上用斜率变化、释放率和回归截距等指标衡量干预效果，并严格冻结所有阈值与判断路径以防分析偏见。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文贡献不在于成功释放，而在于完整揭示失败机制。首先确认抑制具有位置特异性——在中间层观测通道进行激活移植可恢复89%的行为偏移，证明结构真实存在。然而端到端释放仍失败：检测器在分布外完全失效（需干预时从不触发），且即使移除门控，线性方向注入也仅带来单调但远不足的改进，自适应增益几乎为零，表明线性干预本身存在根本局限。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者构建了一个四阶段对比因果门控（CCG）管道：检测是否需干预、执行证据归零前向传播、生成修正方向、注入残差流。关键创新在于全程预注册：所有阈值、模板与决策分支均提前哈希存档。通过移植实验验证定位有效性，再分别测试带门控与无门控的线性释放，分离出‘门控反转’与‘方向有界’两个独立故障点，形成严密证据链。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结论受限于单一小型合成任务，且仅测试线性、单点、加法式干预，不排除非线性或多部位协同释放的可能性。但其价值正在于这份克制——它提供了一个可审计的失败案例，警示简单‘探测即可用’的乐观假设。最值得细读的是其预注册设计、门控诊断流程与剂量响应分析，对任何试图通过激活干预实现可控生成的研究都具方法论示范意义。

papers.title: Causal Structure is Inducible but Functionally Decoupled: The Routing/Readout Boundary of a Typed Mechanism Library
papers.titleZh: 因果结构可被诱导但功能上解耦：基于类型化机制库的路由/读出边界
papers.abstract: When a language model answers an interventional question, the computation it must perform depends on the type of evidence the query requires. We report a decoupling in how a transformer organizes causal knowledge: slot-by-type structure induced by type-level supervision organizes routing, yet remains functionally decoupled from answer readout. We establish this with a typed mechanism library -- discrete mechanism slots partitioned by evidence type, auditable at the state level -- on a causal-world benchmark with exact interventional ground truth, under a frozen protocol, at two scales (22.6M and 125M). Four preregistered findings. (i) Origin. Slot-by-type organization is induced by type-level supervision: absent in architecturally identical unsupervised controls, not buyable by content-free gating labels, and statistically attributable to the supervision signal, replicating at 125M under a powered preregistered protocol (all nine cells passed). (ii) Boundary. The induced structure is a typed routing index with a sharp routing/readout boundary: slot codes scaffold routing but do not drive answer readout ($|Δ\hat{y}| \le 3.4\times10^{-6}$, zero collateral, three seeds, stable across a 5.6x scale window) -- we therefore make no behavioral-editability claim. (iii) Cost. The structure is free: LM quality matches a parameter-matched monolith within 0.0082 nats. (iv) Trust. The library state is exactly local under edit and bit-exactly revertible -- 250 single-edit and 1,000 stacked reverts per seed, zero failures. We further find that the unsupervised null itself moves with scale, so comparisons reusing a null calibrated at one scale may be confounded at another. Every claim is tied to a preregistered, machine-checkable criterion archived before the data it governs; the full audit trail, including one criterion we failed and how the frozen protocol handled it, is released as an appendix.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么显式的内部结构不能直接控制模型行为？当前许多研究假设只要找到模型中的特定神经元或电路，就能通过修改它们来改变输出，这被称为‘电路板直觉’。但该论文质疑这一前提，指出即使能定位结构，也不意味着它真正参与答案生成。问题核心在于：结构的存在是否等于其功能上的介入能力？
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文在一个具备精确干预真值的因果世界测试平台上，构建了一个带有类型化机制库的Transformer模型。输入是结构化因果模型生成的问题与证据类型，输出是干预查询的答案。机制库存储按证据类型划分的功能槽位，通过辅助监督训练路由机制，并在冻结主干的情况下评估编辑操作对读出的影响。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文发现，尽管类型化监督能可靠诱导出机制槽与证据类型的对应结构，但这些结构仅用于路由，完全不驱动最终答案生成——编辑机制内容几乎不影响输出（变化≤3.4×10⁻⁶），且无副作用。这揭示了明确的路由/读出边界，证伪了‘暴露即参与’的普遍假设，同时显示该结构对语言建模性能零成本。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者设计了一种可审计的机制库作为测量工具，每个槽位按证据类型静态分配并支持精确编辑与比特级回滚。通过预注册的统计检验协议，在多个种子和尺度下对比监督与非监督条件，使用互信息量化组织程度，并以结构性编辑验证功能解耦。整个证据链由机器可检查的标准驱动，确保结论不可篡改。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结论基于合成因果世界，尚未验证于真实文本任务；持久性与持续训练下的表现仍待测试。但其价值在于颠覆了对显式结构作用的认知，强调组织存在不等于功能介入。最值得细读的是其实验范式设计、预注册审计流程及对‘移动零假设’的揭示，为未来可解释性研究提供了高可信度方法论样板。

papers.title: Information Abundance Paradox: Long-Context Training Undermines Parametric Knowledge
papers.titleZh: 信息丰裕悖论：长上下文训练削弱参数化知识
papers.abstract: Large language models are increasingly trained and deployed with long contexts that span documents, code repositories, and interaction histories. This scaling reflects the implicit assumption that training on longer contexts will only help the model by exposing it to richer evidence. We challenge this view by studying how the context window shapes a model's mode of learning, shifting it between parametric internalization and contextualization. We propose the Information Abundance Paradox, which hypothesizes that abundant relevant information in the training context can reduce the incentive to encode that information parametrically, thereby increasing reliance on context. In pretraining with long documents, increasing the context window improves language modeling, natural language understanding, and closed-book MCQA only up to an intermediate optimum, after which performance consistently declines. In supervised fine-tuning, more task-relevant train-time context improves performance with supporting context, but reduces robustness when context is absent or misleading at test time. Our analysis suggests that this behavior arises when longer context provides a lower complexity solution. Mechanistically, training with informative context shifts gradient pressure from feed-forward networks, often linked to parametric knowledge, toward attention modules, and causal interventions show that this shift increases reliance on context during inference. Overall, these findings support the Information Abundance Paradox and suggest that scaling toward near-infinite context is not simply a matter of supplying more data, even when high-quality long-context data is abundant.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 当前大语言模型普遍扩展上下文窗口，假设更多上下文总能提升性能。但论文发现，当训练时长期暴露于丰富上下文，模型反而减少将知识存入参数的动机，导致测试时缺乏上下文则表现下降。这揭示了一个被忽视的训练动态问题：上下文长度不仅是数据通道，更会影响模型学习模式的根本选择。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文在预训练和监督微调两种设定下验证该现象。预训练中使用不同长度的上下文窗口训练模型，评估其在语言建模、理解与闭卷问答的表现；微调中控制任务相关文档的数量，测试模型在有无支持或误导性上下文时的鲁棒性。通过固定数据量、模型结构与训练步数，隔离出上下文长度本身的影响。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 研究发现，增加上下文并非持续有益，而是在达到中间最优后性能反转下降。微调中，更多任务相关上下文虽提升有上下文时的准确率，却显著降低无上下文或面对误导时的鲁棒性。这证实‘信息丰裕悖论’存在：丰富的训练上下文促使模型依赖上下文而非内化知识，改变其根本行为模式。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者从理论和机制两方面解释该现象。理论上证明，更长上下文可降低达成相同风险所需的参数化信息量；机制上发现，长上下文训练使梯度更多流向注意力模块而非前馈网络，并增强推理时对上下文的关注。这表明模型学习路径转向了更低复杂度的上下文依赖解。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 实验集中在中小规模模型，更大模型上的拐点位置尚不明确。此外，上下文依赖未必总是负面，关键在于应用场景是否总能提供可靠上下文。论文的价值在于挑战了‘越长越好’的默认信念，其问题设定、机制分析与反直觉结论值得深入阅读，尤其对关注模型泛化与鲁棒性的研究者。

papers.title: Mechanist: AI as a Scientific Instrument for Discovering the Mechanisms of Intelligence
papers.titleZh: Mechanist: 将AI作为科学仪器发现智能的机制
papers.abstract: AI models have achieved remarkable success across diverse domains, yet the mechanisms underlying their capabilities and the risks they may pose remain poorly understood. As AI development becomes faster and increasingly automated, mechanistic exploration remains largely manual, widening the gap between what models can do and our ability to understand and control them. To bridge this gap, we introduce Mechanist, an agentic system that uses AI as a scientific instrument for the autonomous discovery of mechanisms underlying AI intelligence. To support autonomous mechanistic discovery, we construct an interpretability-focused knowledge graph of approximately 13,000 papers and integrate it with a multidisciplinary database of 43 million papers spanning 26 fields. We further curate a library of 32 foundational methods for mechanism analysis, causal intervention, and validation. Compared with Claude Code and existing AI-scientist systems, Mechanist generates more valuable mechanism hypotheses and executes experiments more reliably. Mechanist also demonstrates a progression from discovering model behaviors to explaining and controlling AI models. Specifically, Mechanist first uncovers a counterintuitive safety risk in scientific laboratories, showing that unsafe traits can transfer across modalities through apparently safe training data. Mechanist then develops a mechanism theory of belief, revealing how models represent world knowledge, form beliefs, infer the beliefs of others, and how these mechanisms emerge during pretraining. Finally, Mechanist translates these mechanistic insights into practical interventions that improve model performance across diverse scenarios and steer scientific foundation models toward generating DNA sequences with specified properties.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 当前AI模型能力迅速提升，但其内部工作机制仍不透明，导致理解和控制滞后。现有自动化研究多聚焦于特定任务而非模型本身的机制探索，且依赖人工干预。本文旨在解决如何实现对AI智能机制的自主、系统性发现这一根本问题，特别是在行为风险、信念形成和跨模态影响等方面。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文提出MECHANIST，一个基于多智能体的自主科研系统，通过假设生成、实验执行、验证与迭代四个阶段自动探索AI模型机制。系统结合约1.3万篇可解释性论文的知识图谱与涵盖26个领域的4300万篇跨学科数据库，并集成32种基础机制分析方法，支持从文献检索到因果验证的全流程闭环研究。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: MECHANIST首次实现了对AI模型机制的理论级自主发现。它揭示了看似安全的训练数据可在多模态下传递对立偏好，发现了分离的‘个人信念’与‘归因信念’计算头及其在预训练中的演化路径，并基于此动态干预提升了模型推理一致性。相比Claude Code和现有AI科学家系统，其假设更具新颖性、影响力和可检验性。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 系统采用多源检索策略融合跨学科洞见以生成假设，利用模块化的机制技能库（如探针、稀疏自编码器、因果修补）设计并执行实验。验证代理评估实验有效性与结论稳健性，迭代代理结合独立审查决定修正路径。关键在于将可解释性方法工具化、流程标准化，并通过结构化记忆管理保障研究连贯性。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 系统尚未针对认知模拟类模型优化，且完全自主运行可能存在风险，建议人机协同模式。实验集中在Pythia、Qwen等少数架构，结论普适性需进一步验证。最值得阅读的是其系统框架设计、机制发现案例及对‘AI研究AI’范式的重新定义，为可解释性和安全控制提供了新路径。

papers.title: AI4AI at Test-Time: Strong-to-Weak Capability Transfer via Harnesses
papers.titleZh: AI4AI 在测试时：通过 Harness 实现强模型向弱模型的能力迁移
papers.abstract: Recent work on distillation transfers the capabilities of large models to smaller ones often by updating the latter's parameters, through teacher forcing, on-policy distillation, and related training-time methods. In this paper, we ask whether such transfer can instead occur at test time. We study strong-to-weak scaffolding: whether a stronger builder model can construct inference-time harnesses that help a weaker target model solve tasks more reliably without any parameter updates. Using four representative Theory-of-Mind benchmarks, each builder model uses 5% of the data as a validation set to iteratively refine its harness over multiple rounds, after which the finalized harness is evaluated on the full test set. Empirically, this form of test-time capability transfer is highly effective, nearly doubling average target-model performance from 0.49 to 0.91. Our analysis shows that the gains come primarily from offloading unstable model reasoning into deterministic code, benchmark-specific routing, and strict answer-format enforcement, rather than from encouraging the target model to reason more extensively or sample more broadly. We further find that builder-model reasoning effort improves harness quality monotonically, platform effects are modest relative to the builder model's own capability, and weaker target models receive the largest gains. These results suggest that inference-time harness design is an important complement to conventional training-time distillation, enabling strong models to transfer cognitive structure to weaker models without retraining.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 当前的大模型能力迁移主要依赖训练阶段的知识蒸馏，即通过调整小模型参数来模仿强模型行为。然而这种方法需要重新训练，成本高且不灵活。本文提出一个新视角：能否在不更新参数的情况下，在推理时通过外部结构提升弱模型表现？这触及了模型部署中的核心矛盾——如何低成本释放小模型潜力，而不依赖昂贵的再训练过程。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究设定为‘构建者-目标’双模型框架，其中强模型作为构建者，基于少量验证数据设计推理时的执行环境（称为 harness），用于提升固定弱模型在隐藏测试集上的表现。目标模型不参与训练，仅通过 harness 提供的提示、路由、格式控制等机制进行推理。评估采用四个心智理论（ToM）任务的宏平均准确率，衡量 harness 对目标模型性能的实际增益。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文首次系统验证了测试时能力迁移的有效性：弱模型在强模型设计的 harness 下，平均准确率从 0.49 提升至 0.91，接近人类设计的 harness 效果。结果表明，无需训练即可大幅激活弱模型潜能。更重要的是，这种提升并非来自更复杂的推理引导，而是通过结构化手段减少认知负担，揭示了推理增强的新路径。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 有效 harness 的关键在于将任务结构显式编码为外部规则，而非依赖目标模型内部推理。主要机制包括：将可判定子任务交由确定性代码处理（offloading）、根据题型动态路由、强制输出格式统一、提取结构化状态以简化输入。这些设计将不稳定的人工智能推理转化为可靠程序执行，从而稳定输出。构建者的推理质量直接决定 harness 质量，但平台影响较小。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 方法在高度递归信念追踪和贝叶斯目标推断等难以编译为规则的任务上仍存在瓶颈，残余错误集中于四阶以上递归场景。此外，对目标模型已有较强能力时可能产生干扰。最值得阅读的是其问题设定与实验分析，它为模型增强提供了新范式，并启发未来将 harness 设计本身作为可评测的智能体现。
